extDescription.message: A Steam client enhancement toolkit, also known as Gaben's Smile. This tool is still in early development, with many features still being improved or migrated from the classic extension.

settings_uiLocale_desc.message: Choose the language used by the Steam Buff extension UI. Diagnostic logs stay in Chinese for troubleshooting.

settings_category_extension_settings_des.message: Control the settings center display and module entry points.

settings_category_reminders_desc.message: Game availability, languages, third-party components, and subscription reminders.

settings_category_prices_desc.message: Price history, trends, and sale reminders.

settings_category_wishlist_desc.message: Steam wishlist display and price helpers.

settings_category_data_desc.message: Reviews, online players, playtime, and media scores.

settings_category_smart_search_desc.message: Enhance Steam search with Chinese names and result matching.

settings_category_review_filter_desc.message: Filter Steam store reviews by keywords, regex, playtime, and profile data.

settings_category_translate_desc.message: Webpage translation settings powered by translate.js.

settings_category_ai_desc.message: Model gateway, model, and API key configuration.

settings_category_third_party_services_d.message: Manage external data service keys and connection tests.

settings_category_third_party_desc.message: Third-party integrations, open-source scripts, and external service enhancements.

settings_category_client_desc.message: Steam client library and download page enhancements. Restart Steam after enabling or disabling features on this page.

settings_category_see_desc.message: Inventory enhancements are integrated from the open-source Steam Economy Enhancer extension with some local adjustments.

settings_feature_settings_startup_animat.message: Play the logo startup animation the first time the settings center opens.

settings_feature_search_suggestions_desc.message: Control search suggestion categories and the Steam store search suggestion runtime.

settings_feature_search_suggestions_lock.message: Available to sponsors. Your saved state is restored after activation.

settings_feature_translate_desc.message: Control the translation settings category and webpage translation runtime.

settings_feature_wishlist_price_history_.message: Show a price hover card on Steam wishlist games, including Steam current price, historical low, and SteamPY prices.

settings_feature_store_title_custom_name.message: Show the Steam Buff Chinese title next to Steam store game titles and allow submitting your own Chinese title.

settings_feature_ai_desc.message: Control whether the AI settings category and AI service configuration are enabled.

settings_feature_third_party_services_de.message: Control whether third-party data services are enabled and configure the IsThereAnyDeal API key.

settings_feature_market_tools_desc.message: Control inventory settings and community inventory, market, and trade offer enhancements.

settings_feature_review_filter_desc.message: Control the review filter category and Steam store review filtering.
